details: The Ethereum Foundation recently sold 10,000 ETH through an over-the-counter (OTC) deal at a price of $2,387 per token, totaling approximately $23.87 million. This strategic move is part of the foundation's treasury management. Concurrently, institutional players like Grayscale and Bitmine are significantly increasing their staked Ethereum holdings, pointing towards a growing trend of "treasury rotation into staking."
title: Ethereum Foundation Sells 10,000 ETH OTC; Institutional Staking Rises

details: Crypto exploit losses have surged dramatically in April, exceeding $630 million. This significant increase from March's figures is primarily attributed to two major incidents: the Kelp DAO exploit and the Drift Protocol breach, which collectively accounted for about $576 million. These events underscore a concerning trend of fewer but more impactful attacks within the decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystem.
title: Major DeFi Breaches Drive Crypto Exploit Losses Above $630M in April

details: Morgan Stanley has launched a stablecoin fund, signaling expanding institutional interest in the digital asset space beyond direct cryptocurrency investments like Bitcoin ETFs. This move suggests growing recognition and integration of stablecoins into traditional financial services.
title: Morgan Stanley Enters Stablecoin Market with New Reserve Fund
